column1: # mapping_set_description: A synthetic curated set that deliberately re-asserts triples already
#   present in the EFO / MONDO fixtures, so a worktree load produces same-SPO mapping groups of more
#   than one member (ADR-0013 / ADR-0023). Every triple here is real and taken verbatim from another
#   fixture, except the two skos:closeMatch rows on MONDO:0000234, which form a group that lives
#   entirely inside this one set. See README.md for the group-by-group breakdown.
